info.title: Portway backend — foundation
info.description: Control API with execution state, durable SSE replay and bounded seven-day execution history retention. Run admission intentionally returns 503 until Runtime, capabilities and dispatch fencing are implemented. Execution read/stop/events routes require the execution profile. Approval read/decision, server expiry and stop invalidation are implemented. Model/tool dispatch, Runtime grants, MCP, FCM and packages remain unimplemented. Full readyz stays 503. Internal Harness turn processing and durable final results are implemented with trusted gateway/runtime adapter boundaries. Production model and Runtime adapters are not connected; run admission remains closed. Owner-triggered bounded provider protocol checks persist expiring configuration-bound reports. They do not authorize run admission or attest prompt token bounds. Free-only OpenRouter provisioning/catalog and private counted/reserved model dispatch RPC are implemented. Verified TokenCounter and Runtime remain required before public agent runs. Optional native Codex demo profile provides authenticated prompt, encrypted history, cursor polling and stop through a separately authenticated outbound laptop bridge using existing ChatGPT CLI auth and read-only sandbox. It does not open generic run admission or replace the target Runtime/approval/reviewer pipeline. Agent Bridge v2 (0.8.0): the same opt-in laptop bridge serves Codex CLI and Claude Code; the phone selects provider/model/effort, sees an encrypted bridge snapshot with accounts, models and usage limits (explicit exhausted state, 429 AI_LIMIT_EXHAUSTED preflight) and connects/switches AI accounts through one-time bridge commands that drive the official CLI OAuth flows. Legacy fields and the first-slice bridge stay compatible.

Replay durable run events and continue with live SSE
get.description: Authenticate with Authorization and X-Device-Session headers only. Use either Last-Event-ID or cursor, never both; omitted cursor starts at 0. SSE id is run UUID:seq, event is RunEvent.type, data is RunEvent JSON. Supports run.created/run.state_changed approval_requested/approval.resolved, run.completed and tool_result. Payloads contain references and safe metadata, not model answers or tool output. Comment heartbeats have no id. Each page rechecks live authorization; failure closes the stream, and reconnect returns an HTTP error. Expired history is rejected before 200. Bounded polling interval 1 second, heartbeat 10 seconds, stream lifetime 30 minutes, four streams per API process. Does not create runs or expose task/instructions.

post.description: Explicit owner action. At most two model generations with fixed nonsecret prompts, max_tokens=128 each and a 12-second total model timeout (15-second attempt deadline). No tool command is executed. The 202 acknowledgement and check_id are committed before I/O; replaying the same key never repeats model I/O, even after an interrupted attempt. Read capabilities and protocol_valid through GET /v1/providers. PUT invalidates the report; successful reports expire after 30 minutes. Errors are safe codes within the report. This check does not establish tokenizer bounds or Runtime readiness. Current configuration/device are checked before each request; final publication uses version/check_id CAS. A new key after an expired attempt explicitly requests a fresh probe.

get.summary: List current explicit zero-priced OpenRouter text models
get.description: Metadata GET only. No generation, credentials, model router or paid models. Availability/tool behavior still requires a real probe.

post.summary: Create an encrypted provider connection using the control API OPENROUTER_API_KEY
post.description: Owner/device and Idempotency-Key required. The selected explicit :free model must have current zero pricing. Key is read only from control environment, encrypted with AAD, never returned. Replay creates no additional secret/provider; a changed environment key does not silently rotate existing providers. This operation does not generate or authorize a run.

post.summary: Private model gateway count
post.description: Service auth AND live owner/device credentials required. Reads current execution state over authenticated HTTP; no cross-service SQL. Checks agent/provider/version/report/epoch/deadline. Count uses a verified full-prompt TokenCounter, absent by default (TOKEN_COUNT_UNAVAILABLE); it never generates. Complete matches the counted body/reservation and durably claims the step before I/O. Replays use an encrypted cached reply; uncertain attempts are never retried. In-flight authority changes cancel HTTP. Public run admission remains closed pending a verified tokenizer, Runtime and real acceptance.

codexBridgeKey.description: Dedicated laptop bridge credential; never ship to mobile client

protocol_valid.description: Evaluated using current provider/config/allowlist and database time. Protocol compatibility alone does not authorize run admission.

provider_version.description: Pinned control provider config version. Required by model RPC; absent only on historical/test snapshots.

snapshot_cursor.description: Present on GET run and stop run responses. Resume after this snapshot with Last-Event-ID.

EventCursor.description: Run UUID followed by its durable event sequence; integer range 0..9223372036854775807.

prompt.description: Limit enforced in UTF-8 bytes; whitespace-only and NUL rejected

model.description: Null/absent or "default" = provider default; must be listed in the bridge snapshot when the snapshot lists models

effort.description: Must be supported by the Codex model; ignored for Claude models without effort support

error_code.description: AI_LIMIT_EXHAUSTED, AI_AUTH_REQUIRED, AI_RUN_FAILED, AI_TIMEOUT, CODEX_BRIDGE_LOST, DEVICE_REVOKED (legacy rows may contain CODEX_EXEC_FAILED)

prompt_preview.description: Whitespace-collapsed first ≤120 characters (list and get; null in the admission response)

meta.description: Bridge report only, on completed; stored in run columns and omitted from replayed events

providers.description: Last bridge snapshot; empty before the first snapshot, stale when connected=false

login.description: Latest login flow from the last 15 minutes

commands.description: Delivered once; payload is wiped server-side after delivery

system.description: Laptop default CLI login; cannot be removed via API

id.description: five_hour, weekly, weekly_opus, weekly_sonnet or another id (use window_minutes)

reset_at.description: Only when exhausted: when usage becomes possible again

url.description: HTTPS only; host in {auth.openai.com, chatgpt.com, claude.ai, claude.com, platform.claude.com, console.anthropic.com}

error_code.description: LOGIN_FAILED, DEVICE_CODE_UNAVAILABLE, CODE_REJECTED, CLI_MISSING, LOGIN_TIMEOUT, COMMAND_EXPIRED, CODEX_BRIDGE_LOST
